# ListenerFalloff <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ListenerFalloff:Void mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | `0` is the curve of this runtime, `1` the curve of the original and `2` the curve of SoLoud, see [CreateListener](CreateListener). Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Picks the curve that the volume of 3D sounds falls off by with distance, for the sounds that play now and the ones that start later. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* [SetFalloff](SetFalloff) only changes the sounds that start after it, and [SetChannelFalloff](SetChannelFalloff) one sound. A curve can not glide from one to the other.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Everything with the curve of the original, from now on.
ListenerFalloff 1
```
